authorization: 用户明确要求继续放松位移和形变，并建立统一调参入口：调整后自行运行吸引排斥+其他后处理，与原后处理比较统计，生成同100例对比图。
algorithm: Unchanged deformation.py V3 central-force / area-mass / anisotropic-stress algorithm. New Parameters subclass removes old experimental budget ceilings; validates positive finite settings. No objective/weight/model change.
current_single_setting: tuning.json:20 rounds, per-step center budget5% initial shortest side, cumulative40%; shape dimension factor per step1.03, cumulative1.5 (reciprocal lower bound). One setting only, no automatic parameter sweep.
panel: Fixed v5 dev_monitor500 indices0..99, unchanged original split_v1 and public MIB mean-area task; same saved C3 own-Loss-best drafts. No network inference, training, full dev500, test or automation.
baseline: Original no-preprocessor planner on identical saved C3 draft. Auto mode reuses frozen completed original output only when source/planner hashes, effective options and member binding match. A changed planner or fresh mode runs a matched baseline once per member; sequential alternating order. Cached historical time is labeled unpaired, never used to claim speedup.
run_identity: Canonical numerical settings, effective planner options, panel/source hashes and geometry/planner/data/scoring source hashes define numerical cache equivalence. Full solve source snapshots remain immutable. Display/renderer/test changes are audited separately and do not trigger new solves. Label and config formatting do not change numeric identity. Completed identical runs reuse results. Resume checks numerical identity and completed cases.
reports: Original-vs-hybrid official neutral-runtime Q, legality, soft constraints, bbox/wire, paired win/tie/loss, weighted influence and leave-one-out sensitivity; exact raw overlap/union void, coverage<10% and worst module, center/shape/area/lock audits, CPU resident draft-stage timing mean/P95. No new Loss-Q study.
render: User-corrected main view: raw draft / previous-best AR draft / current AR draft / current full final. Previous best is a single whole completed prior compatible version, lowest final weighted Q on the same100, frozen before this run started; no per-case mixing or new numeric selection. Auto reference currently V3 10 rounds. Optional comparison.previous_best_run pins a compatible saved run. View bindings include both current/prior coordinate hashes. Shared visualization, common IDs/scale, no controls/UI opening, no new solve. Old views retained.
lifecycle: One OS-released process lock; STOP at case/arm boundaries; atomic per-case records/NPZ and resumable rendering. Errors preserve evidence and require explicit resume, no automatic retry/wakeup. Fixed output root under this experiment/runs/tuning. Latest is chronological, never best-by-Q.
timing: Resident CPU draft->AR->same planner->hard checks; NN/input construction/transfers excluded. Cold native warmup separate; batch throughput not claimed; other user jobs not paused.
